la:other:Sthenelus.gloss: The name of several male characters in Greek mythology.
senses: The name of several male characters in Greek mythology.
la:other:Sthenelus.html:
Sthĕnĕlus, i, m., = Σθένελος.
King of Mycenœ, son of Perseus, and father of Eurystheus, .—
King of the Ligurians, father of Cycnus, who was changed into a swan, and who, from his father, is called proles Stheneleïa, ; cf. sqq.—
One of the Epigoni, charioteer of Diomede at the siege of Troy, and one of those shut up in the wooden horse, ; ; .—
A Rutulian, slain by Pallas, .—Hence.
Sthĕnĕlēĭus, a, um, adj., Stheneleian.
(Acc. to I.) Eurystheus, : hostis,i. e. Eurystheus,.—
(Acc. to II.) Proles, i. e. Cycnus, .—
Sthĕnĕlēis, ĭdis, adj. f., Stheneleian: volucris,i. e. Cycnus,.
